title: Fix Email Inbox retention policy failing on missing indirect Read permission
summary: Email Inbox retention policy no longer fails due to missing indirect read permission and now registers the table for existing tenants through an upgrade tag.
key_points: Added Email Inbox to the email module's Record Reference adapter to provide indirect read permission
Implemented per-company upgrade tag to register Email Inbox in retention-policy allowed tables for existing tenants
Added tests validating Email Inbox retention policy with and without filters under restrictive permissions
No schema or public API changes; idempotent upgrade tag re-registers all three email tables harmlessly
